blocks.text: OLONGAPO CITY — More than 170 green sea turtle hatchlings found in separate nests within the Aurora Watershed Forest Reserve were released along the coast of Baler, Aurora, the Department of Environment and Natural Resources said on Sunday, Oct. 11. The hatchlings were released along the coasts of Sitios Diguisit and Dicasalarin in Barangay Zabali, according to Marivic Santos, head of the Community Environment and Natural Resources Office in Maria Aurora. The DENR, the Baler municipal environment office and local beach resort operators carried out the release.
